notes: There are no local-development docs in the repo. The README only links to self-hosting guides on docs.solidtime.io (not readable here), and CONTRIBUTING only covers lint commands. These steps are reconstructed from docker-compose.yml, .env.example and CI. Steps marked convention come from the compose/Sail configuration rather than prose docs. The compose stack relies on an external Traefik reverse proxy: an external Docker network named reverse-proxy-docker-traefik_routing, a proxy at REVERSE_PROXY_IP 10.100.100.10, and hosts entries for solidtime.test, vite.solidtime.test and storage.solidtime.test. Nothing in the repo explains how to set this up. Inside the container the app runs `artisan serve` on port 80 and is reached at APP_URL https://solidtime.test, so no host port is given. CI runs on the host instead: PHP 8.3, Node 20, Postgres on 127.0.0.1 via .env.ci, with Octane/FrankenPHP serving on port 8000. composer.json pins PHP to 8.3.*. minio (S3 disk) and gotenberg (PDF) are part of the dev stack but probably not needed for the first page to load. Running `npm run dev` makes the build step unnecessary. Whether passport:keys is strictly required for the first page load is unverified; both CI workflows run it.
